name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-sandbox
description: Runs model-written Python and project tests in a throwaway container: no network, hard limits.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_RUNTIME
environmentVariables.description: Container runtime the code runs under; the daemon must know it.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_IMAGE
environmentVariables.description: Image the code runs in.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_DOCKER_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Docker Engine API of the node.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_USER
environmentVariables.description: Numeric uid:gid the code runs as; never root.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MEMORY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Memory of one run, with no swap on top.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_CPUS
environmentVariables.description: CPUs of one run.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_PIDS
environmentVariables.description: Processes and threads of one run at once.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS
environmentVariables.description: Runs on the node at once.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a run gets when the call names none.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Most seconds a call may ask for.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_OUTPUT_LIMIT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Bytes kept of stdout and of stderr each: half from the start, half from the end.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_OUT_FOLDER_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Size of /out.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_TMP_FOLDER_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Size of /tmp.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_OUTPUT_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Files returned from /out.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_INPUT_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Files one call may pass.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_INPUT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest input file.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_INPUT_TOTAL_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: All input files of one call.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_ALLOWED_HOSTS__0
environmentVariables.description: Hosts input links may point at, as host or host:port; further hosts as __1, __2…. None by default: every link is refused.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_DOTNET_IMAGE
environmentVariables.description: Image a .NET project is built and tested in.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_NODE_IMAGE
environmentVariables.description: Image a Node project is built and tested in.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_RESTORE_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Docker network the restore stage fetches packages over; never host or container:.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_RESTORE_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: The restore proxy's address as a restore container reaches it, such as http://mcp-sandbox:3128; every host a restore asks for is answered as network. Unset, the proxy is off.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_RESTORE_PROXY_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the restore proxy listens on inside the server, set together with SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_RESTORE_PROXY.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_RESTORE_HOSTS__0
environmentVariables.description: Hosts the proxy reaches though their address is loopback, link-local or private, such as a package mirror on the node's own network; further hosts as __1, __2…. A public address needs no naming.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_CACHE_VOLUME_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Prefix of the package volumes, one per toolchain.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_TEST_MEMORY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Memory of one test run, with no swap on top.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_TEST_CPUS
environmentVariables.description: CPUs of one test run.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_TEST_PIDS
environmentVariables.description: Processes and threads of one test run at once.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_TEST_TMP_FOLDER_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Size of /tmp in a test run.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_CONCURRENT_TEST_RUNS
environmentVariables.description: Test runs on the node at once, apart from program runs.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_DEFAULT_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a test run gets when the call names none, restore and build included.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Most seconds a call may ask for a test run.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_PROJECT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Most bytes a project may unpack to.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_MAX_PROJECT_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Most files a project may hold.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SANDBOX_WORK_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Folder on the server's own disk where inputs wait for the copy into the container. The temp folder when unset.
